title: East Carolina Coleslaw
description: A classic Southern-style creamy coleslaw with cabbage, carrot, and a tangy mustard-mayonnaise dressing.

items: 8 cups shredded cabbage, outer leaves removed (about 1/2 regular head of cabbage)
2 tablespoons Dijon mustard or coarse ground mustard
1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, or more to taste
1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper, or more to taste

Quarter the cabbage through the core, then cut out the core. Cut each quarter crosswise in half and finely shred, or shred in a food processor. Place the shredded cabbage in a very large bowl (you will have 6 to 8 cups).
Add the shredded carrot and onion to the cabbage and toss to mix.
In a separate bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, mustard, celery seeds, salt, and pepper. Taste for acidity and seasoning, then adjust as desired.
Pour two-thirds of the dressing over the cabbage and carrot, then mix well (clean hands are the quickest tool).
If the coleslaw seems dry, add a little more dressing. Eat right away or refrigerate about an hour to let the flavors mingle and the cabbage soften.
